title: Clear single refinements
body: Something similar has been asked before, but with a different output wanted. What we basically need is a way to clear these 9 filters separately and **not** all at once with the current [clearRefinements](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/clear-refinements/js/). So basically `clearRefinements` for every single "filtergroup". Is something like this possible with instantsearch.js?

comments.body: This is possible if you use the `transformItems` to filter out the  refinements & only keep the one you actually want to clear. Hope that helps!

Hi @MrMooky another option could be to leverage `includeAttributes`.
Here is an example that shows how it's done
https://codesandbox.io/s/ais-ecommerce-demo-app-yxvf8

I hope this helps. I'll close this for now. Do not hesitate to reopen if this hasn't solved your issue!
@tkrugg That solves my issue. Thanks a lot. Easier than I thought. :)
